recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a female figure in western attire set against a vast, sun-drenched desert landscape, framed by a dusty pink border and topped with stylized, vintage-inspired typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The dusty pink border echoes the metallic pink of the subject's jacket.
The warm, sepia-toned landscape provides a neutral ground for the vibrant subject.
The typography is stacked and centered, creating a formal, balanced header.
The subject's hat and belt buckle anchor the vertical axis of the composition.
coreInvariants: High-noon desert lighting with soft shadows
Western-style display typography with decorative flourishes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body portrait from the waist up, centered horizontally and vertically in the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and wide-brimmed hat serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top typography, move down to the subject's face, and follow the fringe of the jacket toward the belt buckle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive sky and desert floor provide significant breathing room around the central figure.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and ochre tones define the landscape and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dusty pink is used for the border and the primary text color.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic pink and gold are used for the subject's clothing and accessories.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, vintage saturation with a slightly yellow-tinted white point to simulate aged film.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Slab serif and decorative western scripts
letterConstructionRules: Heavy, blocky slab serifs for the primary name
Concave or 'fisheye' distortion on the horizontal bars
Ornate, swash-heavy script for the secondary title
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'P' in the secondary title features an elongated, decorative descender
The 'A' in the primary name has a low, stylized crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, masculine slab serif paired with a lighter, feminine decorative script.
graphicDevices: Symmetrical filigree/swirls flanking the secondary title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the classic wild-west woodblock aesthetic.
Provides the weathered, decorative western feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle desert landscape with Joshua trees and distant mountains under a pale blue sky. Place a woman in the center wearing a pink fringed jacket, cowboy hat, and jeans. Apply a warm, vintage film filter and a dusty pink border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a bold, pink western slab serif at the top. Below it, add the secondary title in a dark grey decorative script flanked by gold filigree.

verificationChecks: Is the border color consistent with the jacket?
Is the typography centered and legible against the sky?
Does the image have a warm, sun-bleached vintage quality?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Cohesive pink and ochre color palette

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent lighting on the subject and landscape.
Ensure the pink border does not crop essential visual elements.
Verify the typography feels integrated into the sky rather than pasted on.
Confirm the vintage grain is uniform across the entire image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered Western Portrait + Vintage Desert Backdrop + Slab Serif Header + Decorative Script Subheader + Tonal Border Frame
